snippet.title: WE'RE TRYING OUTWARD 2 ON A POTATO PC! POTATO SPECS PC TRAILER - RELEASE DATE TRAILER
snippet.description:
Mister Potato - Nine Dots new Tech guy - explores the wide capability of the game at the lowest settings.

If you can't handle Outward 2 at its lowest, you don't deserve it at its best.

Check all the info and PC specs here https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2849490/view/528753960533624588

All resolutions in the requirements graphic use quality upscaling
